composition: Tufo cliff settlement above a deep gorge · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks across the gorge at Pitigliano's famous cliff perch from the opposite slope. The honey-colored town crowds the top of the sheer tufo cliff across the left and center of the frame, its church tower rising above the rooftops, while the forested gorge drops away to the right. The modelled 23 September 2026, 08:14 morning sun gilds the cliff face, and the houses seem to grow straight out of the rock they stand on.
